title: Design System: EZ Garage Doors — Orange Editorial Utility
northStar: A beautifully organized work order: condensed ink type on warm paper, one orange track system carrying the eye, everything in service of a phone call or a written-estimate request.

sanctionedUses: hero photo frame (one-time CSS draw-in, 700ms, post-LCP, reduced-motion static)
process rail (steps hang from horizontal/vertical run)

budget: hero track draw-in (once, stroke-dashoffset, 700ms ease-out 150ms delay)
sticky mobile bar slide-in (160ms, after 160px scroll)
motion.reducedMotion: all transitions/animations disabled globally; track draw-in renders complete

contrastRules: body text: ink (#24272b) on paper/white only
white on orange: >=24px regular or >=18.66px at 700 weight only — .btn is pinned at 1.175rem (18.8px/700) for this
small orange TEXT on light grounds: orange-text (#b23f0e, >=4.75:1 on paper/white/alt/pale); orange-deep (#d65312) is a hover BACKGROUND only — it measures 4.1:1 on white and fails as small text
on-ink secondary text: ink-soft (#c9cdd2); muted notes: ink-mute (#9aa1a9) — no ad-hoc grays
steel (#626a73) secondary text at >=15px on white/paper only
CTAs on orange fields: ink or white-on-ink, never orange

voice.claimsGate: every factual claim must exist in website/src/config/business.ts APPROVED_CLAIMS/STATS
